events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in rural New York in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being at Woodstock in '69. Three days of peace, love, and legendary music that shaped a generation. What's your ultimate festival anthem from that era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977, he would have been 91.

angles.name: Elvis Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's influence on music is undeniable, a true icon who would have been 91 today. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, he would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a giant. Tupac Shakur's lyrics and legacy continue to resonate, he would have been 55. His impact is still felt today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, he would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever; he would have been 84. Still inspiring generations of musicians.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks – pure genius. What's your favourite moment from this timeless record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon released 'Imagine' in the UK. A powerful message of peace that continues to resonate globally. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's the Lennon lyric that stays with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true showman. Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80, a voice and stage presence unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
